ums_navigation_path: UMS > Placement Services > View Eligible Drives / Register
prerequisite_action: Ensure 0 active backlogs (unless drive allows) and minimum CGPA criteria met on UMS profile.
required_documents: Updated Resume (LPU format), placement registration slip, project portfolio, certificates
escalation_ladder: 1. Placement Coordinator -> 2. Head, Division of Career Services (Block 32)

required_documents: Student ID card (or registration number; medical triage takes precedence over paperwork)
escalation_ladder: 1. Casualty Medical Officer -> 2. Chief Medical Officer (Block 30)
provenance_notes: 24x7 emergency medical triage in Block 30 Uni-Hospital with dedicated campus ambulance fleet.

prerequisite_action: Check daily specialist availability schedule on UMS before walking into OPD for non-emergencies.
required_documents: Student ID card, medical prescription booklet (provided at registration)
escalation_ladder: 1. OPD General Physician -> 2. Visiting Specialist -> 3. Medical Superintendent
provenance_notes: Routine OPD consultations booked through UMS or hospital reception counter.

ums_navigation_path: UMS > Relationship Management System (RMS) > Psychological Counseling / Book Slot

required_documents: Student ID (for slot check-in only; sessions are private and confidential)
provenance_notes: Confidential mental health guidance supporting student wellbeing.
